results.snippet: Dramatic footage released by Russia's Africa Corps shows a high-risk rescue operation that freed 24 Malian soldiers who had reportedly been held captive by militants for more than six months. The operation took place in the In-Tebezas region, southeast of Kidal, and involved a joint mission by Africa Corps personnel and Malian special forces.
